6bdab49e-effd-4494-8980-75ee3936c9ed/Eve.en: While walking there <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> hears shouts coming from behind, and<NL>looks back to see a Valley of Flowers disciple who comes running up the road.<NL>"Taiwu, Taiwu. Stop a minute..."
6bdab49e-effd-4494-8980-75ee3936c9ed/Eve.cn: 此日<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>正行于路上，只听得自身后传来声声呼唤，<NL>回头便见得一名百花谷弟子匆匆奔来：<NL>“太吾，太吾请留步……”
6bdab49e-effd-4494-8980-75ee3936c9ed/Eve.ru: Во время прогулки там <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> слышит крики, доносящиеся сзади, и<NL>оглядывается назад и видит ученика из Долины цветов, который бежит вверх по дороге.<NL>- Тайу, Тайу. Остановись на минутку..."

b6caf4e0-7da5-4a30-85de-c110a87b5e05/Eve.en: The Valley of Flowers disciple runs up to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> and says respectfully after calming down a little.<NL>"By order of my two founders, I'm here to invite you to White Deer Marsh. They want to talk with you there.<NL>The matter is of great importance. Please take it seriously..."
b6caf4e0-7da5-4a30-85de-c110a87b5e05/Eve.cn: 百花谷弟子奔至<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>面前，稍定气息恭敬问候道：<NL>“在下奉二位祖师之命，特来请太吾前往白鹿泽一叙，<NL>此事事关重大，还望太吾多着意几分……”

fd48c904-7f57-4066-8af5-73e3faf31d86/Eve.en: The Valley of Flowers disciple makes a troubled grimace at this and says with a sigh after a while.<NL>"Well... Since both my founders want your help with the matter, it must be very complicated.<NL>I was there with my founders,<NL>but I can't tell you more about it..."<NL>Hearing this, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> feels a stirring of curiosity...
fd48c904-7f57-4066-8af5-73e3faf31d86/Eve.cn: 百花谷弟子闻言面露难色，过了一会儿方才长叹道：<NL>“此事……既然由二位祖师亲请，肯定是相当棘手……<NL>虽说在下也随两位祖师去过，<NL>却是不敢妄言……”<NL>此言一出，不免令<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心生好奇……

c42b96d9-fec8-4580-ae3d-fc63b3ab25cd/Eve.en: The Valley of Flowers disciple draws closer and whispers.<NL>"I'm really not supposed to say anything but based on what I have seen and heard<NL>I think it bears a remarkable resemblance to the previous plague of madness..."<NL>Astonished, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> persists eagerly...
c42b96d9-fec8-4580-ae3d-fc63b3ab25cd/Eve.cn: 百花谷弟子不觉压低了嗓音，凑近道：<NL>“虽说弟子不应胡乱揣测，但仅以在下所见所闻……<NL>自是觉得，竟与早先的疯病之事，多有相似之处……”<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>顿惊，急忙追问……
c42b96d9-fec8-4580-ae3d-fc63b3ab25cd/Eve.ru: Ученик из Долины цветов подходит ближе и шепчет.<NL>"Я действительно не должен ничего говорить, кроме как основываясь на том, что я видел и слышал<NL>Я думаю, что это имеет поразительное сходство с предыдущей эпидемией безумия..."<NL>Изумленный, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> настойчиво упорствует...

c42b96d9-fec8-4580-ae3d-fc63b3ab25cd/Opt.en: What resemblance? Is there any deathly energy again?
c42b96d9-fec8-4580-ae3d-fc63b3ab25cd/Opt.cn: 如何相似？可是又有死气生发？
c42b96d9-fec8-4580-ae3d-fc63b3ab25cd/Opt.ru: Какое сходство? Есть ли снова какая-нибудь смертоносная Энергия?

2936e4cb-4151-4771-b031-9310746de141/Eve.en: With slightly bowed head the Valley of Flowers disciple tries to recall the details.<NL>"I'm not sure if there's any deathly energy...<NL>But an unknown weird disease has been spreading across the villages in White Deer Marsh.<NL><NL>Black bumps of different sizes are found in many villagers.<NL>The symptoms are mainly weakness, nausea, dizziness, confusion.<NL>The disease can't be cured with common medicines against cold, Phlegm heat, and Yin depletion,<NL>nor through acupuncture, moxibustion, plaster therapy, or blood-letting therapy.<NL>All Valley of Flowers disciples have tried their best to treat the patients but they can only cure the symptoms, not the disease..."
2936e4cb-4151-4771-b031-9310746de141/Eve.cn: 百花谷弟子抚颌垂首，细细回忆：<NL>“在下也不知是否与死气有关……<NL>只是在白鹿泽的各个村寨中，都起了一种无名怪病，<NL><NL>许多村民身上，都长出了大小不一黑色肿块，<NL>病症多为乏力、恶心、头晕、神志不清，<NL>寻常医治风寒、痰热、亡阴之药皆难祛病根，<NL>无论针灸、艾灸、贴药、放血之法也是成效寥寥，<NL>谷中弟子尽心竭力医治，却只能治其表症……”

2936e4cb-4151-4771-b031-9310746de141/Opt.en: But the Valley of Flowers is famous for its medical arts in the world. Is there any other way?
2936e4cb-4151-4771-b031-9310746de141/Opt.cn: 百花以医道闻于天下，当真没有办法？
2936e4cb-4151-4771-b031-9310746de141/Opt.ru: Но Долина цветов славится своим медицинским искусством во всем мире. Есть ли какой-нибудь другой способ?

0b8b95a1-0c31-4759-87ae-4b17bd28e44b/Eve.en: The Valley of Flowers disciple gives a deep sigh, dejected.<NL>"Of course there are ways to relieve the symptoms. But there's still no way to eradicate the illness.<NL>Since the breakout of the madness disease, Valley of Flowers disciples have been learning from our founders and studying hard day and night.<NL>With our current medical skills and knowledge, we can only suppress the disease so the infected villagers can live a normal life.<NL>Only our two founders can eradicate such an odd disease.<NL><NL>But the disease will attack repeatedly if its cause is not figured out.<NL>So I'm sent here to find you and ask you to help Valley of Flowers..."
0b8b95a1-0c31-4759-87ae-4b17bd28e44b/Eve.cn: 百花谷弟子长叹一声，神色黯然：<NL>“方法自然是有，但终究治标不治本，<NL>自从先前经疯病一事，师兄弟们时时向两位祖师请教，日夜精修不辍，<NL>现下尚能以所学医法抑制病发，令染病村民生活无碍，<NL>如此怪症，也唯有两位祖师能以神术根除之，<NL><NL>但是缘由探寻不明，定会反复发作，<NL>故而遣在下来寻太吾，还请助我百花谷一臂之力……”

0b8b95a1-0c31-4759-87ae-4b17bd28e44b/Opt.en: I'll do anything to help the people!
0b8b95a1-0c31-4759-87ae-4b17bd28e44b/Opt.cn: 为苍生除害，我自是义不容辞！
0b8b95a1-0c31-4759-87ae-4b17bd28e44b/Opt.ru: Я сделаю все, чтобы помочь людям!

0b8b95a1-0c31-4759-87ae-4b17bd28e44b/Opt.en: As Taiwu, I'm duty-bound to help the common people.
0b8b95a1-0c31-4759-87ae-4b17bd28e44b/Opt.cn: 救助黎民百姓，亦是太吾之责……
0b8b95a1-0c31-4759-87ae-4b17bd28e44b/Opt.ru: Как Тайу, я обязан помогать простым людям.

0b8b95a1-0c31-4759-87ae-4b17bd28e44b/Opt.en: Since the Valley of Flowers has asked, I'll do my best.
0b8b95a1-0c31-4759-87ae-4b17bd28e44b/Opt.cn: 既是百花谷有请，我尽力而为便是……
0b8b95a1-0c31-4759-87ae-4b17bd28e44b/Opt.ru: Поскольку Долина цветов попросила, я сделаю все, что в моих силах.

0b8b95a1-0c31-4759-87ae-4b17bd28e44b/Opt.en: I certainly will go and check out such a strange thing.
0b8b95a1-0c31-4759-87ae-4b17bd28e44b/Opt.cn: 这等稀奇之事，我当然要去看上一看……
0b8b95a1-0c31-4759-87ae-4b17bd28e44b/Opt.ru: Я обязательно пойду и проверю такую странную вещь.

0b8b95a1-0c31-4759-87ae-4b17bd28e44b/Opt.en: Well, what is the Valley of Flowers going to give me for that?
0b8b95a1-0c31-4759-87ae-4b17bd28e44b/Opt.cn: 如此一说，百花谷打算以何赠礼谢我？
0b8b95a1-0c31-4759-87ae-4b17bd28e44b/Opt.ru: Ну и что же Долина цветов даст мне за это?

ae250ff9-af20-4778-bc9b-d08fd120aaf0/Eve.en: Hearing this the Valley of Flowers disciple breathes a sigh of relief and says cheerfully with a fist-and-palm salute.<NL>"I was told that you are principled person with great aspirations.<NL>Now we've met. I'm very impressed.<NL>Unfortunately our two founders are too busy taking care of the sick people in White Deer Marsh.<NL>So I'd like to thank you on behalf of all members of the Valley of Flowers."
ae250ff9-af20-4778-bc9b-d08fd120aaf0/Eve.cn: 百花谷弟子闻言长舒一口气，欣然抱拳拱手道：<NL>“早知太吾刚正不阿，胸怀壮志，<NL>今日一见，果教在下叹为观止，<NL>可叹两位祖师为白鹿泽中各地病况所累，着实难以脱身，<NL>在下只有代百花谷的各位同门，先行谢过了……”

ae250ff9-af20-4778-bc9b-d08fd120aaf0/Opt.en: May I ask where the two founders are?
ae250ff9-af20-4778-bc9b-d08fd120aaf0/Opt.cn: 不知两位祖师现在何处？
ae250ff9-af20-4778-bc9b-d08fd120aaf0/Opt.ru: Могу я спросить, где находятся два основателя?

491c235a-0bbe-46f2-9e40-567b570b6b43/Eve.en: The Valley of Flowers disciple replies respectfully.<NL>"Master Bai is treating patients in <Settlement key=BaiSettlement str=Name/> and<NL>Master Xuan is giving treatment in <Settlement key=XuanSettlement str=Name/>.<NL>I'm sure you will find them there.<NL>It's very important. Please always keep it in mind."
491c235a-0bbe-46f2-9e40-567b570b6b43/Eve.cn: 百花谷弟子立刻恭敬回道：<NL>“白祖师正在<Settlement key=BaiSettlement str=Name/>中救助病患，<NL>玄祖师正在<Settlement key=XuanSettlement str=Name/>中诊治疾症，<NL>太吾前去，定能寻得，<NL>此事甚重，万望太吾记挂于心……”

491c235a-0bbe-46f2-9e40-567b570b6b43/Opt.en: You go first. I'll set off after I have finished the business here.
491c235a-0bbe-46f2-9e40-567b570b6b43/Opt.cn: 你自先行回报，我此间事了，自当前往……
491c235a-0bbe-46f2-9e40-567b570b6b43/Opt.ru: Ты идешь первым. Я отправлюсь в путь после того, как закончу здесь свои дела.

49f9ed17-1b03-4661-83e1-d8aa27ba1ee4/Eve.en: Elated at this the Valley of Flowers disciple smiles, and says delightedly with a fist-and-palm salute.<NL>"I was told that you are benevolent and generous.<NL>Now we've met. I think you are truly admirable.<NL>Unfortunately our two founders are too busy taking care of the sick people in White Deer Marsh.<NL>So I'd like to thank you on behalf of all members of the Valley of Flowers."
49f9ed17-1b03-4661-83e1-d8aa27ba1ee4/Eve.cn: 百花谷弟子闻言慨然而笑，快然抱拳拱手道：<NL>“早知太吾乃仁人君子，心怀苍生，<NL>今日一见，果然令人叹服，<NL>可叹两位祖师为白鹿泽中各地病况所累，着实难以脱身，<NL>在下只有代百花谷的各位同门，先行谢过了……”

49f9ed17-1b03-4661-83e1-d8aa27ba1ee4/Opt.en: May I ask where the two founders are?
49f9ed17-1b03-4661-83e1-d8aa27ba1ee4/Opt.cn: 不知两位祖师现在何处？
49f9ed17-1b03-4661-83e1-d8aa27ba1ee4/Opt.ru: Могу я спросить, где находятся два основателя?

46471205-b6dd-46ff-b721-df4f3e18e789/Eve.en: The Valley of Flowers disciple says sincerely with a fist-and-palm salute, the eyebrows unbent a little.<NL>"I was told that you are easy-going and impartial.<NL>I'm really relieved that you said yes.<NL>Unfortunately our two founders are too busy taking care of the sick people in White Deer Marsh.<NL>So I'd like to thank you on behalf of all members of the Valley of Flowers."
46471205-b6dd-46ff-b721-df4f3e18e789/Eve.cn: 百花谷弟子愁眉稍展，用力抱拳拱手道：<NL>“早知太吾顺势而为，不偏不倚，<NL>今日能请得太吾相助，当真令我松了口气，<NL>可叹两位祖师为白鹿泽中各地病况所累，着实难以脱身，<NL>在下只有代百花谷的各位同门，先行谢过了……”

46471205-b6dd-46ff-b721-df4f3e18e789/Opt.en: May I ask where the two founders are?
46471205-b6dd-46ff-b721-df4f3e18e789/Opt.cn: 不知两位祖师现在何处？
46471205-b6dd-46ff-b721-df4f3e18e789/Opt.ru: Могу я спросить, где находятся два основателя?

b7776917-9817-4d2d-a15a-def8b5191dcd/Eve.en: The Valley of Flowers disciple says gratefully with a fist-and-palm salute, eyebrows trembling.<NL>"I was told that you are an open-minded person with a strong personality.<NL>Now we've met. I think you are very remarkable.<NL>Unfortunately our two founders are too busy taking care of the sick people in White Deer Marsh.<NL>So I'd like to thank you on behalf of all members of the Valley of Flowers."
b7776917-9817-4d2d-a15a-def8b5191dcd/Eve.cn: 百花谷弟子闻言眉头微颤，反复抱拳拱手道：<NL>“早知太吾不拘一格，特立独行，<NL>今日一见果然……不同凡响，<NL>可叹两位祖师为白鹿泽中各地病况所累，着实难以脱身，<NL>在下只有代百花谷的各位同门，先行谢过了……”

b7776917-9817-4d2d-a15a-def8b5191dcd/Opt.en: May I ask where the two founders are?
b7776917-9817-4d2d-a15a-def8b5191dcd/Opt.cn: 不知两位祖师现在何处？
b7776917-9817-4d2d-a15a-def8b5191dcd/Opt.ru: Могу я спросить, где находятся два основателя?

978bddee-1c34-4cae-8e9c-fb96a03d1841/Eve.en: The Valley of Flowers disciple is speechless for a while and says with a fist-and-palm salute.<NL>"I was told that you are fearless and swift as... a tiger.<NL>Now we've met. I'm deeply... impressed...<NL><NL>I'm sure the two founders will arrange the reward for you.<NL>Unfortunately they are too busy taking care of the sick people in White Deer Marsh.<NL>So I'd like to thank you on behalf of all members of the Valley of Flowers."
978bddee-1c34-4cae-8e9c-fb96a03d1841/Eve.cn: 百花谷弟子闻言张口结舌，过了片刻方才抱拳拱手道：<NL>“早知太吾睥睨天下，迅猛如……虎，<NL>今日一见，果然令在下……印象深刻……<NL><NL>谢礼之事，两位祖师定有安排，<NL>只可惜他们为白鹿泽中各地病况所累，着实难以脱身，<NL>在下只有代百花谷的各位同门，先行谢过了……”

978bddee-1c34-4cae-8e9c-fb96a03d1841/Opt.en: May I ask where the two founders are?
978bddee-1c34-4cae-8e9c-fb96a03d1841/Opt.cn: 不知两位祖师现在何处？
978bddee-1c34-4cae-8e9c-fb96a03d1841/Opt.ru: Могу я спросить, где находятся два основателя?

b76af73e-2af9-4228-a0f0-7a0f2dcd8380/Eve.en: Following the guidance of the Valley of Flowers disciple, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/><NL>heads to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=CurAreaName /> where Bai Wuyang is.<NL><NL>When the village comes into sight not far away, all <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/><NL>can see are withered grass and trees around the village in the bleak stillness.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> can't hear any roosters crowing or dogs barking, nor see any people hanging out...
b76af73e-2af9-4228-a0f0-7a0f2dcd8380/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>根据百花谷弟子指引，<NL>向着白无恙所在的<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=CurAreaName />而去，<NL><NL>待<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>来到距村寨不远处时，<NL>却看见村寨周围草木凋敝，凄风阴垂，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>既听不到鸡犬相鸣之声，也看不见人丁往来之状……

b2e69435-37ed-4bb3-8b17-5180378918a6/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> walks slowly to glance across the villagers around,<NL>and sees dark aura floating around the villagers' chests.<NL>As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> looks fixedly the dark aura is gone without a trace.<NL>But there are dark spots, swollen or sunken, on many villagers' bodies.
b2e69435-37ed-4bb3-8b17-5180378918a6/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>放缓脚步，目光扫过四处的村民，<NL>正看见似有几分黑气在村民心口处流转，<NL>待<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>定睛细察之际，却不见分毫黑气的踪迹，<NL>唯有诸多村民的身上，皆有乌黑斑块，或肿或陷……

b2e69435-37ed-4bb3-8b17-5180378918a6/Opt.en: (What disease do they have? Why do the symptoms remind me of deathly energy?)
b2e69435-37ed-4bb3-8b17-5180378918a6/Opt.cn: （此何病症……竟然与死气有几分相似……）
b2e69435-37ed-4bb3-8b17-5180378918a6/Opt.ru: (Какая у них болезнь? Почему симптомы напоминают мне о смертельной Энергии?)

588fc86b-267c-4d98-bef2-5b5e852ab3dc/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> walks along the lanes into a house in the center of the village<NL>and is greeted with a strong mixed smell of herbal medicines<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> sees many surgical dressings scattered in the house, all wet and blackened.<NL>With a frown and her head bent, Bai Wuyang is carefully removing the bandage from a villager's wound.<NL><NL>Seeing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, Bai Wuyang gives a slight nod without stopping what she is doing.<NL>Though feeble and sick, the villager is trembling in fear and sweating.<NL>"Eh, doctor. How are you gonna treat me?<NL>I've always been terrified of pain. Oh..."
588fc86b-267c-4d98-bef2-5b5e852ab3dc/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>循着村路行走，入得村中央的屋内，<NL>顿时闻到百般草药混合的浑厚之味直直扑来，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>看见屋内散落诸多敷料，尽被染作湿漉暗褐，<NL>白无恙正皱眉俯首，细细为眼前村民解下病处纱布，<NL><NL>见得<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，白无恙微微颔首，手中举动迅捷依旧，<NL>那村民纵是气虚体弱，也已战战兢兢，冷汗如雨：<NL>“……大夫，待会儿要怎么……怎么治病喔？<NL>我从小就怕疼喂……”

588fc86b-267c-4d98-bef2-5b5e852ab3dc/Opt.en: (With Bai Wuyang's Hands of Salvation, things will get better...)
588fc86b-267c-4d98-bef2-5b5e852ab3dc/Opt.ru: (С помощью "Рук спасения" Бай Уяна все станет лучше...)

b5bbcc79-f10d-4284-b587-03a40e927a21/Eve.en: "Relax. I can easily cure you right away."<NL>Bai Wuyang chuckles as she is about to start the treatment.<NL>But the villager is still in a state of nervous anxiety.<NL>She pats the villager's shoulder and points at the roof beam.<NL>"Look. What's that?"<NL><NL>The moment the villager looks up, Bai Wuyang's Hands of Salvation burst out with brilliant rays.
b5bbcc79-f10d-4284-b587-03a40e927a21/Eve.cn: “不必多想，无非须臾举手之劳，弹指间便手到病除。”<NL>白无恙嗤嗤一笑，正待施为，<NL>但见村民噤若寒蝉模样，<NL>随即纵手一拍其肩，指向房梁，<NL>“你且看那是什么？”<NL><NL>待村民抬头刹那，白无恙神手绽放光芒，已直直而出……

c351d6f1-87bb-4632-9365-853e8e383bfb/Eve.en: The Hands of Salvation move swiftly and go suddenly into the villager's chest like crazy antlers,<NL>separating the bones and flesh into layers, and stopping the blood flow.<NL>Snow-white True Qi bursts out from Bai Wuyang's finger tips and reaches the infected part of the villager's body.<NL>Her fingers churn and soon the dark spots are all removed from the flesh.<NL><NL>Before the villager knows it, Bai Wuyang has already waved her arms lightly to<NL>extract and pull out all the dark energy.<NL>Then she claps her hands to destroy it all.
c351d6f1-87bb-4632-9365-853e8e383bfb/Eve.cn: 神手翻飞，有如鹿角横冲，瞬息没入村民胸膛，<NL>立时骨肉分离，层叠有致，血液停驻，凝而未散，<NL>雪白真气自白无恙指间寸寸迸发而出，深达村民染病之处，<NL>十指翻飞，眨眼间，已将血肉间乌黑斑驳之处尽数摘下，<NL><NL>未等村民回过神，白无恙早已轻巧挥动双臂，<NL>一提一拉，将团团阴黑之气全数取出，<NL>再一合掌，即将之悉数摧灭……

c351d6f1-87bb-4632-9365-853e8e383bfb/Opt.en: What's this? It's too thin to be deathly energy.
c351d6f1-87bb-4632-9365-853e8e383bfb/Opt.cn: 此乃何物？若为死气，却是太薄……
c351d6f1-87bb-4632-9365-853e8e383bfb/Opt.ru: Что это? Она слишком тонкая, чтобы быть смертоносной Энергией.

f34ff554-7788-4cbf-beb1-67fd8b8491a4/Eve.en: After the villager falls into a temporary trance, Bai Wuyang shakes her head with a sigh.<NL>"It's corpse energy, made of residual energy of the dead that is stimulated and refined by dark arts.<NL>Not as tough as deathly energy, it can be removed easily.<NL>Thanks to the energy that has gathered for many years in White Deer Marsh, corpse energy can be wiped out and the patients will fully recover."
f34ff554-7788-4cbf-beb1-67fd8b8491a4/Eve.cn: 眼见村民暂时陷入恍惚，白无恙方才扶额摇头，轻叹曰：<NL>“此乃尸气，用逝者残留的生气，经邪法催化而炼成的，<NL>但不像死气那般凝实，轻轻一拨便可摘取，<NL>以白鹿泽经年所聚之气涤荡，自然便能将尸气拔除，病患自可无恙……”

cf7ab29c-0f7f-459f-a33f-927583b559b4/Eve.en: Bai Wuyang replies gently after a fist-and-palm salute.<NL>"That's the point. I guess the disciple already told you everything.<NL>The Valley of Flowers could really use your help with this.<NL><NL>I have questioned the infected villagers here. They all mentioned a quack doctor who practiced medicine here.<NL>But their details do not correspond. This person was the last one in the village to be infected.<NL>I hope you can make a survey."
cf7ab29c-0f7f-459f-a33f-927583b559b4/Eve.cn: 白无恙抱拳一礼，柔声相应；<NL>“正为此事，想必那弟子已向太吾讲明，<NL>还望助百花谷一臂之力，<NL><NL>日前我已细细问过村中染病之人，皆提到有一江湖郎中游医至此，<NL>细节之处，却是多有出入，此人便是村中最后一位染病之人，<NL>如今正请太吾一察……”

cf7ab29c-0f7f-459f-a33f-927583b559b4/Opt.en: How much does the villager remember?
cf7ab29c-0f7f-459f-a33f-927583b559b4/Opt.cn: 却不知这位村民还记得多少……

f34a7abf-49fa-4576-ac12-7293b8150c65/Eve.en: As they speak, the villager has recovered consciousness and is checking and searching.<NL>After realizing that all dark spots have been removed, the villager pours forth a torrent of thanks with tears of gratitude.<NL>"Thank you! Thank you, doctor. It's a miracle!"<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> can't help smiling at this.
f34a7abf-49fa-4576-ac12-7293b8150c65/Eve.cn: 说话间，村民倒已恢复精神，不住在身上摸索张望，<NL>待察觉黑斑尽除后，忙不迭紧抱双掌感激涕零：<NL>“多谢神医！多谢神医！”<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>见状，不禁莞尔……

f34a7abf-49fa-4576-ac12-7293b8150c65/Opt.en: (The Hands of Salvation save lives, as smoothly and naturally as flowing water.)
f34a7abf-49fa-4576-ac12-7293b8150c65/Opt.ru: ("Руки спасения" спасают жизни так же плавно и естественно, как текущая вода.)

2aadcfc0-196e-454a-80df-b058321ddcb6/Eve.en: Bai Wuyang asks with a bright smile.<NL>"You've said enough thank-you. Now search your memory and tell me.<NL>When did those black spots first appear on you? What were the symptoms when you felt terrible?"<NL>Bai Wuyang is very blunt and straightforward, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/><NL>is also curious about the villager's experience.
2aadcfc0-196e-454a-80df-b058321ddcb6/Eve.cn: 白无恙灿然一笑，旋即问道：<NL>“客套便免了，你且细细回想，<NL>这些黑斑自何时而起？你这身子不适又是如何发端的？”<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>见白无恙仍是快人快语，<NL>亦是好奇村民所见所闻……

4342a7fc-0f46-41c1-ad6d-0895831914fe/Eve.en: Before the villager can say anything, a commotion is heard outside.<NL>It starts with scolding and screams, followed by noises of breaking and smashing.<NL>What is going on outside?
4342a7fc-0f46-41c1-ad6d-0895831914fe/Eve.cn: 未等村民开口应答，却听屋外喧哗大起，<NL>先是怒斥惊呼，又有打砸响动，<NL>吵吵嚷嚷，也不知出了什么变故……
4342a7fc-0f46-41c1-ad6d-0895831914fe/Eve.ru: Прежде чем житель деревни успевает что-либо сказать, снаружи слышится шум.<NL>Все начинается с ругани и криков, за которыми следуют звуки ломки.<NL>Что происходит снаружи?

be9b9e8f-25c7-42ac-83d5-7b84ae0967dd/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> and Bai Wuyang rush out of the house.<NL>Outside, a scene of chaos and tension is created by a crowd of people.<NL>The villagers are staring and whispering in groups, too frightened to come any closer.<NL>On the ground, there are a few fragments of medicine jars,<NL>and splashes of sticky deep brown medicine decoction from which curls of white pungent smoke are rising.<NL><NL>With a sniff of the smoke, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/><NL>immediately figures out that some rotten poison must have been mixed in the medicine,<NL>and then hurries toward the crowd, wondering what is going on there...
be9b9e8f-25c7-42ac-83d5-7b84ae0967dd/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>与白无恙冲出房屋，<NL>只见一众人正围作一团，嘈杂声不绝于耳，<NL>村民皆惊惧不安聚作几群，窃窃私语不敢靠近，<NL>地上碎裂摇晃着数块药罐碎片，<NL>粘稠暗褐的药液四溅横淌，窜出阵阵刺鼻白烟，<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>略一细闻，<NL>当即分辨出药中被掺入了朽气森森的怪毒，<NL>再看众人群聚，心下奇怪，忙往前去……

9dd10f28-f7e8-4e3e-95e2-96238cf2ffd7/Eve.en: In the middle of the crowd, several Valley of Flowers disciples, red with anger,<NL>surround another Valley of Flowers disciple. One of them shouts in a sharp tone.<NL>"Who are you? What did you add to the decoction?!<NL>How wicked-hearted you are trying to poison the infected villagers!"<NL><NL>The Valley of Flowers is known for being benevolent and a leader of all medical workers.<NL>Astonished, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/><NL>turns to look at the person surrounded by the crowd...
9dd10f28-f7e8-4e3e-95e2-96238cf2ffd7/Eve.cn: 人群中央，几名百花谷的弟子正气得面红耳赤，<NL>将另一名百花谷弟子团团围住，正听一人高声呵斥道：<NL>“你是何人？在煎制的汤药中加了什么！<NL>怎生出这般狼心狗肺妄图暗害病中百姓！”<NL><NL>百花谷向来以仁善之名著称，更为天下医者之宗，<NL>闻得此言，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>亦是震惊，<NL>急急看向人群中被围之人……

2f6cffae-6046-4ac2-adf6-ba87955d0118/Eve.en: The surrounded "disciple" puts on an innocent face and makes up excuses.<NL>"Even if you don't remember me, you should remember our sect rules!<NL>I noticed that the decoction was poisoned and was planning to report it.<NL>But you seized me without giving me any chance to explain myself."
2f6cffae-6046-4ac2-adf6-ba87955d0118/Eve.cn: 被围住的“弟子”双目乱转，故作委屈状，仍旧抵赖：<NL>“师兄！就算你记不得我，总该信门规罢！<NL>我分明是看出药里被人下了毒，正想报告，<NL>谁知你便不由分说将我拿下……”
2f6cffae-6046-4ac2-adf6-ba87955d0118/Eve.ru: Окруженный "ученик" делает невинное лицо и придумывает оправдания.<NL>"Даже если ты меня не помнишь, ты должен помнить правила нашей Секты!<NL>Я заметил, что отвар был отравлен, и собирался сообщить об этом.<NL>Но вы схватили меня, не дав мне ни малейшего шанса объясниться."

91b5cfff-8d82-43b8-89a4-23c348701c3a/Eve.en: The exiled disciple and the disciple are in a violent quarrel<NL>when Bai Wuyang interrupts them, ablaze with anger, and pours out sharp reproofs upon the exiled disciple.<NL>Her tone is as sharp as a blade and she speaks as fast as a gale.<NL><NL>"How dare you!<NL>The good states of your kidney and liver show that you have learned the Orthodox Nine Needles Acupuncture.<NL>All your meridians are sealed, and your True Qi is all eliminated, which shows that you were once disciplined by the Valley of Flowers!<NL>Sly-looking with a high-bridged nose and clean-cut features.<NL>You were the disciple taken in by the eldest Deer-Robed Envoy nine years ago!"<NL>When she reveals that, the crowd falls into silence. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is also taken aback.
91b5cfff-8d82-43b8-89a4-23c348701c3a/Eve.cn: 眼看那百花弃徒已与百花谷弟子争得面红耳赤，<NL>不想白无恙更是气急，早就冲来劈头盖脸怒叱弃徒，<NL>其声利若快刀剖病，其语迅若疾风扫叶：<NL><NL>“犯下祸事还敢抵赖！<NL>你肾水丰沛，肝木葱郁，乃是正练九针十二原之相，<NL>但周身经脉被封，内力真气消弭，分明是受过百花谷中惩戒！<NL>眉宇狡黠，人中不辨，骨相挺拔，<NL>你便是九年前，最为年长的鹿裳使所收的旧徒！”<NL>此番论断一出，人声为之一静，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>亦是暗暗称奇……

91b5cfff-8d82-43b8-89a4-23c348701c3a/Opt.en: (Bai Wuyang still remembers the background of every Valley of Flowers disciple...)
91b5cfff-8d82-43b8-89a4-23c348701c3a/Opt.cn: （白无恙前辈却还记得每一位百花谷弟子的身份来由……）
91b5cfff-8d82-43b8-89a4-23c348701c3a/Opt.ru: (Бай Уян до сих пор помнит предысторию каждого ученика Долины цветов...)

086f5912-5807-455b-ac39-da49cbd0453b/Eve.en: Unaware of that, Bai Wuyang continues reproaching the exiled disciple furiously.<NL>"You were caught robbing your sectmates by your fellow brother. And you attempted to kill this brother to keep his mouth shut.<NL>You were seized by the guard, but you denied everything<NL>until Scarlet Case Disciple proved you guilty with physical evidence.<NL>As a result the Leader wiped all the martial arts from you and expelled you from the Valley of Flowers.<NL>How dare you mix yourself into the medical team and poison the medicine. That was malicious and traitorous!"<NL>Faced with the evidence, the exiled disciple is speechless with a sigh of regret.
086f5912-5807-455b-ac39-da49cbd0453b/Eve.cn: 白无恙全无理会，仍是风风火火地斥责此人：<NL>“你因抢夺同门功法，被你师兄抓获，还妄图杀人灭口，<NL>被守卫拿下后也是矢口否认，<NL>非得朱匣弟子拿出物证，方才哑口无言，<NL>故而门主才废去你一身功法，将你逐出百花谷，<NL>今日你又胆敢混入这治病队伍，还往药中投毒，安的什么居心！”<NL>件件事实罗列，那弃徒已是无言以对，空有哑然自艾……

7e8039f3-cfac-4ae1-a6d8-2079db8a273f/Eve.en: The exiled disciple seems to have given in. So the Valley of Flowers disciples walk over to seize the exiled disciple<NL>who suddenly becomes violent, with all the muscles and bones bursting open and growing rapidly.<NL>Then there is malicious and brutal dark aura gushing out to shroud the exiled disciple's ferocious body.<NL>All the villagers flinch with horror at the sight of that, pushing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> to move with them.
7e8039f3-cfac-4ae1-a6d8-2079db8a273f/Eve.cn: 众百花弟子见这弃徒似已认命，当即上前，正待将此人拿下，<NL>却不料那弃徒猛然暴起，其浑身筋骨骤然崩裂疯涨，<NL>阴邪狂戾的黑气随即汹汹涌现，缠绕在弃徒狰狞的躯壳上，<NL>周遭村民早被惊得失声，连连后退，却将<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>也挤在其中……

80ca016a-67c3-4bdf-b6ce-45c36695e970/Eve.en: The Valley of Flowers disciples are shocked a moment, then surround the exiled disciple, and try to get the exiled disciple under control.<NL>But empowered by the dark aura, the exiled disciple's moves become so unpredictable and brutal<NL>that all the surrounding disciples can't close further in on the exiled disciple.<NL><NL>Having recognized that the malicious dark aura on the exiled disciple is refined corpse energy, just like the one that infected the villagers, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/><NL>can't help flying out of the crowd of panicked villagers and plunging into the siege.<NL>The exiled disciple glares at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> before coming at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/>.
80ca016a-67c3-4bdf-b6ce-45c36695e970/Eve.cn: 众百花弟子先是一惊，旋即齐齐合围弃徒，试图将其制服，<NL>然而这弃徒在诡谲黑气催动下功力大盛，其招式也变得怪诞凶利，<NL>令众多弟子一时徒有围困，近身不得，<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>已觉出这等阴损黑气与村民所染如出一辙，皆为凝炼尸气，<NL>已顾不得许多，立刻自慌乱村民间纵步飞身，跃入包围之中，<NL>那弃徒赫然瞪来，旋即嘶吼着冲袭而至……

828e0c3e-a101-4b8e-a11c-a8c84daa6e24/Eve.en: Though empowered by the black energy, the Valley of Flowers Exiled Disciple is still no match for the remarkable <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>.<NL>Soon <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> seizes the exiled disciple<NL>who then cries and struggles violently in vain.<NL><NL>Bai Wuyang comes hurrying up, thanks <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> hastily,<NL>and glares at the exiled disciple. As the Hands of Salvation gleam,<NL>she seals all the joints of the exiled disciple's body and asks sternly.<NL>"You treacherous rat. How dare you!<NL>Tell me. Where does this deathly corpse energy come from?! Why did you spread the corpse energy?<NL>What's your part in the plague of this place? Who do you work for? Who do you work with?"
828e0c3e-a101-4b8e-a11c-a8c84daa6e24/Eve.cn: 饶是百花弃徒强借诡力，仍敌不过<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>盖世武功，<NL>不多时便被<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>擒住拿下，<NL>弃徒唯有怪叫着，徒劳奋力挣扎，<NL><NL>白无恙快步走来，匆匆与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>道过谢，<NL>旋即怒目紧盯弃徒，神手微灿，<NL>封住其周身关节，厉声喝问：<NL>“背师弃门的逆徒，如何敢混进行列！<NL>说！这害命损寿的尸气从何而来！为何散播尸气行这等孽事！<NL>此地怪病与你有何关联！谁人指使！又有何人与你勾连！”

c66dde24-45b5-4900-a104-2c817e3290c3/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is temporarily overwhelmed by the Valley of Flowers Exiled Disciple's various unpredictable moves.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> has to fall back, step by step, waiting for a chance to fight back.<NL>The exiled disciple shouts and strikes more arrogantly and excitedly as the pursuit progresses.<NL><NL>But suddenly there's a white flash, and all joints of the exiled disciple's body are sealed.<NL>Bai Wuyang collects the Hands of Salvation, and hastens to lift <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> up gently.
c66dde24-45b5-4900-a104-2c817e3290c3/Eve.cn: 百花弃徒怪招异式频出，使<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>短时间难以适应，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>步步后退，试图寻觅时机反击，<NL>弃徒见状愈发狂躁兴奋，口中嘶吼着挥爪逼近，<NL><NL>但见白芒一闪，立时将弃徒周身关节尽数封住，<NL>白无恙收回神手，快步走来伸臂轻轻扶起<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>……

c66dde24-45b5-4900-a104-2c817e3290c3/Opt.en: Thank you, Bai Wuyang, for your help.
c66dde24-45b5-4900-a104-2c817e3290c3/Opt.ru: Спасибо тебе, Бай Уян, за твою помощь.

c32447e4-9b2a-4707-a27f-c40d5ebc0c3c/Eve.en: "Hahaha. The best medics heal the world.<NL>As a well-known sect, the Valley of Flowers<NL>focuses on treating and curing useless and foolish people in fields and on the streets.<NL>Funny! Sad!<NL><NL>Since I left the boring sect, I have been taught by Guru.<NL>That was how I know that medics can not only cure the sick and the wounded, but also control death.<NL>The way of Guru is halfway to immortal and a way back to youth.<NL>It's the real medical arts and also the way of salvation. Hahaha!"<NL><NL>The Valley of Flowers exiled disciple laughs loudly and crazily, feeling absolutely no sense of shame.<NL>Bai Wuyang and <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> frown heavily as the exiled disciple babbles on and on.
c32447e4-9b2a-4707-a27f-c40d5ebc0c3c/Eve.cn: “哈哈哈！上医医世，<NL>百花谷堂堂一方大派，<NL>却终日困于田垄街巷，只知疗愈些无用愚民，<NL>可笑！可悲！<NL><NL>自从我离了谷中那枯燥之地，得了真师教诲，<NL>我才知医者，不仅能救死扶伤，更可驾御死亡，<NL>真师之道，已可半步化生，重返青春，<NL>此乃真正医道，此乃救世之道，哈哈哈！”<NL><NL>百花弃徒非但毫无愧色，反倒放声大笑，状若疯癫，<NL>口中胡言喋喋不休，令白无恙与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>俱是眉头紧皱……

c32447e4-9b2a-4707-a27f-c40d5ebc0c3c/Opt.en: Don't talk nonsense! Just the facts!
c32447e4-9b2a-4707-a27f-c40d5ebc0c3c/Opt.cn: 休要信口开河，从实说来！

26e4ff77-a834-4ee1-a6df-d90a718952c4/Eve.en: Bai Wuyang gives <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> a gentle consoling pat,<NL>and turns to glare at the exiled disciple and questions asks sternly.<NL>"You treacherous rat. How dare you!<NL>Tell me. Where does this deathly corpse energy come from?! Why did you spread the corpse energy?<NL>What's your part in the plague of this place? Who do you work for? Who do you work with?"
26e4ff77-a834-4ee1-a6df-d90a718952c4/Eve.cn: 白无恙轻拍一下<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>以示无事，<NL>转而怒目嗔视弃徒，厉声喝问：<NL>“背师弃门的逆徒，如何敢混进行列！<NL>说！这害命损寿的尸气从何而来！为何散播尸气行这等孽事！<NL>此地怪病与你有何关联！谁人指使！又有何人与你勾连！”

26e4ff77-a834-4ee1-a6df-d90a718952c4/Opt.en: (Walk up to subdue the exiled disciple...)

18944b36-0831-43e6-a495-bdc1b242f466/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> has just finished when<NL>the Valley of Flowers Exiled Disciple starts trembling violently, face distorted.<NL>Then the exiled disciple murmurs, with a face full of tears, half-smiling and half-sobbing.<NL>"Don't be pleased by birth nor feel resentful about death... Birth forces me into labor, and death allows me to rest forever..."<NL><NL>Together with the strange words,<NL>there are puffs of white energy drifting out of the exiled disciple's body, which is obviously life energy of human.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> and Bai Wuyang are both shocked and hasten to stop it...
18944b36-0831-43e6-a495-bdc1b242f466/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>话音为未落，<NL>百花弃徒却已面容扭曲，浑身颤抖，<NL>转而涕泗横流，似哭似笑，口中喃喃自语：<NL>“不知说生，不知恶死……劳我以生，息我以死……”<NL><NL>诡谲声调一起，<NL>竟见缕缕凝实白气从其体内逸散而出，赫然却是人之生气，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>与白无恙俱是大惊，急欲阻拦……

8a61c5b5-1cab-4d00-97f1-b262e6ead981/Eve.en: After <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> seizes the exiled disciple by three vital parts,<NL>Bai Wuyang's Hands of Salvation go into the exiled disciple's body.<NL>The life energy is already flooding out.<NL>In an instant, there's no essence, Qi, spirit, or will left in the exiled disciple's body<NL>which turns stiff and falls forward.
8a61c5b5-1cab-4d00-97f1-b262e6ead981/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>方制住弃徒三处要害，<NL>白无恙神手正探入弃徒体肤，<NL>外溢生气已然滚滚淌出，<NL>仅一息之间，弃徒之精、气、神、意俱溃，<NL>徒留一具僵劲之躯直直不动，向前倒去……

8a61c5b5-1cab-4d00-97f1-b262e6ead981/Opt.cn: 竟有如此骇人的自戕之法……

119e6da4-3e2f-4016-8d4d-e7ab7977d46f/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> and Bai Wuyang catch the exiled disciple's body and hasten to examine it.<NL>Bai Wuyang controls the Hands of Salvation, frowning.<NL>"Weird... So weird. The life energy is gone as if it has never been there.<NL>But how could corpse energy and life energy coexist? And enabled the sudden burst of corpse energy.<NL>And also used corpse energy to gain power until become as mad as beasts."
119e6da4-3e2f-4016-8d4d-e7ab7977d46f/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>与白无恙立刻接住弃徒之尸，急急查看，<NL>白无恙神手翻动，眉头紧皱：<NL>“怪……太怪了！生气尽散，却似从未有过一般，<NL>可如何才能令尸气与生气混在一处，还可骤然爆发尸气，<NL>更兼驱使尸气以增长气力，狂乱近兽……”

119e6da4-3e2f-4016-8d4d-e7ab7977d46f/Opt.en: Even you can't figure out the cause?
119e6da4-3e2f-4016-8d4d-e7ab7977d46f/Opt.cn: 便是前辈也分辨不出来由吗？
119e6da4-3e2f-4016-8d4d-e7ab7977d46f/Opt.ru: Даже ты не можешь выяснить причину?

f293c11e-fc31-42fb-92fc-cf28dd3938ad/Eve.en: Bai Wuyang is lost in contemplation.<NL>When <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> rises to stare,<NL>Bai Wuyang suddenly claps her hands excitedly and says, her eyes lighting up.<NL>"I got it! Birth and death are complementary! Yin and Yang interact with each other. There's no birth without death.<NL>But with only the Birth of the Octomancy Requiem, how did..."
f293c11e-fc31-42fb-92fc-cf28dd3938ad/Eve.cn: 白无恙不语，沉思出神，<NL>待<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>起身望去，<NL>白无恙才似骤然惊醒般猛地一拍双掌，目中精光乍现道：<NL>“是了！生死相依，阴阳相衡，有死所落，必有生起……<NL>可八生八死之法唯有生法，如何能这般……”

6c4e0b9e-fd70-430c-a590-48b95d231d14/Eve.en: Bai Wuyang shakes his head and hastens to say, looking a little incredulous.<NL>"It has some connection with the Octomancy Requiem. But only a little connection.<NL>For more information, I will have to examine this corpse.<NL>But it's inconvenient in the village. Let's wait until we return to the Valley of Flowers..."<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> turns around and sees<NL>that many villagers are looking out of half-open windows or doors.<NL>Many of them are still pale and sickly-looking.
6c4e0b9e-fd70-430c-a590-48b95d231d14/Eve.cn: 白无恙摆手摇头，目中仍有几分难以置信，只匆匆道：<NL>“与八生八死之法有些关联，却又大有出入，<NL>具体如何，还待我查解此尸，<NL>只是村中多有不便，且待回得百花谷中再论……”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>望向身后，<NL>诸多村民正微开门扉，兀自张望，<NL>其中不少仍是面有病色……

22b92b37-526f-4bbc-8840-933d63122b89/Eve.en: Bai Wuyang rises, adjusts her dress, and says in a clear voice.<NL>"Of course I won't leave until I cure all the villagers.<NL>After I have completed the business here, Wuyou and I will wait for you in the Valley of Flowers.<NL><NL>I don't think there's anything more to look into here. You have found the clues for me.<NL>It's not easy to cure all the villagers. We need all the help we can get.<NL>Don't worry. I'll organize it.<NL>Remind Wuyou of it when you see him."
22b92b37-526f-4bbc-8840-933d63122b89/Eve.cn: 白无恙起身抚衣，朗声道：<NL>“自是待我将村民尽数疗愈后，方才回谷，<NL>待此间事了，我自当与无忧一同在百花谷中，恭候太吾，<NL><NL>此地只怕已无别事可寻，太吾已为我寻得线索，<NL>疗愈一村之事甚繁，到底还需群力可为，<NL>有我坐镇，太吾勿忧，<NL>见得无忧时，还望他提醒一声便是……”

4acde063-dadf-4cff-a53e-cc2063de87ec/Eve.en: Bai Wuyang expresses her gratitude with a fist-and-palm salute,<NL>and then begins to clean the village with the Valley of Flowers disciples before treating the patients.<NL>The disciples also observe the patients, learn about their symptoms,<NL>and fill the prescriptions and boil medicine for the patients who are free of corpse energy.<NL>Before long, the village is in good order again.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> feels a little relieved at this.
4acde063-dadf-4cff-a53e-cc2063de87ec/Eve.cn: 白无恙抱拳一礼道过谢，<NL>便携百花谷弟子收拾村巷，再行问诊除病，<NL>众弟子亦是为村民诊脉问疾，<NL>替已除去尸气的病患抓药煎制，<NL>不多时，村寨中再度井井有条，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>见状，也无需协助，心下略松……

4acde063-dadf-4cff-a53e-cc2063de87ec/Opt.en: (Go to the Valley of Flowers someday...)

365bd864-e947-4c19-87e8-b619d8663422/Eve.en: Following the guidance of the Valley of Flowers disciple, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> arrives at the White Deer Marsh,<NL>and then leaves for <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=CurAreaName /> where Xuan Wuyou is.<NL><NL>When the village comes into sight not far away, all <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/><NL>can see are deserted fields and withered trees facing the crimson glow of the setting sun.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> can't hear any birds chirping, nor see any children playing...
365bd864-e947-4c19-87e8-b619d8663422/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>根据百花谷弟子指引，到得白鹿泽，<NL>正向玄无忧所在<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=CurAreaName />而去，<NL><NL>待<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>来到距村寨不远处时，<NL>但见外沿田荒树枯，残阳血照，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>既听不到鸟鸣禽呼之声，也看不到童稚嬉戏之状……

912cbd64-39f7-42f3-82f9-fcd1c0eed21a/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> runs fast to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=CurAreaName />.<NL>In the village, there are a lingering smell of Herbs and people whispering.<NL><NL>Valley of Flowers disciples, with medicines and needles in hand, are moving in a hurry in lanes.<NL>All windows and doors are wide open. Words of kind advice can be occasionally heard inside the houses.<NL>There are also some villagers leaning on each other, sighing and groaning...
912cbd64-39f7-42f3-82f9-fcd1c0eed21a/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>加快脚步奔至<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=CurAreaName />，<NL>进入村内，方才闻到药材绵长之味，听到交头接耳之音，<NL><NL>只见百花谷弟子携药提针，匆匆穿梭在屋巷之间，<NL>房舍的门窗全部大开，偶尔从屋内传出细细叮嘱之声，<NL>更有些许村民正相互搀扶着，唉声叹息不绝于耳……

0f0dda61-d8ed-4e60-8ff0-ad40f54d02a9/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> walks faster toward <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=CurAreaName />.<NL>In the village, there are a heavy smell of Herbs and people whispering.<NL><NL>Valley of Flowers disciples, with medicines and needles in hand, are moving in a hurry in lanes.<NL>All windows and doors are wide open. Words of kind advice can be occasionally heard inside the houses.<NL>There are also some villagers leaning against the wall, lost in thought, sighing and groaning...
0f0dda61-d8ed-4e60-8ff0-ad40f54d02a9/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>不由疾步奔至<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=CurAreaName />，<NL>待进入村庄，方才闻到药材醇厚之味，听到人言交头接耳之音，<NL><NL>只见百花谷弟子携药提针，匆匆穿梭屋巷，<NL>房舍门窗俱是大开，偶尔有细细叮嘱之声传出，<NL>更有些许村民倚墙静坐、出神等候，长吁短叹不绝于耳……

17500f21-2883-487b-b691-28404c99e77e/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> walks slowly to glance across the villagers around,<NL>and sees dark aura lingering on the villagers' foreheads.<NL>As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> looks fixedly the dark aura is gone without a trace.<NL>But there are black lumps, spreading or gathering, in many villagers' foreheads.
17500f21-2883-487b-b691-28404c99e77e/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>放缓脚步，目光扫过四处的村民，<NL>正看见似有几分黑气盘踞于村民眉间，<NL>待<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>定睛细察之际，却不见黑气丝毫痕迹，<NL>唯有诸多村民面门上，皆有黑色淤结，或散或淤……

17500f21-2883-487b-b691-28404c99e77e/Opt.en: (What disease do they have? Why do the symptoms remind me of deathly energy?)
17500f21-2883-487b-b691-28404c99e77e/Opt.cn: （此何病症……竟然与死气有几分相似……）
17500f21-2883-487b-b691-28404c99e77e/Opt.ru: (Какая у них болезнь? Почему симптомы напоминают мне о смертельной Энергии?)

e62837ba-a825-4ae4-8e85-23749cfb04f3/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> walks along the lanes into a house in the center of the village,<NL>and catches the unique smell of medicinal herb sachets.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> sees needles glittering as they are inserted and scattered in a white cloth that is dotted with blood.<NL>Xuan Wuyou is concentrating on inserting acupuncture needles into a villager's body.<NL><NL>Seeing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, Xuan Wuyou smiles a cheerful smile without stopping inserting needles.<NL>"Hello, Taiwu. Come on in.<NL>I'm a little busy here. Please wait a bit."
e62837ba-a825-4ae4-8e85-23749cfb04f3/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>循着村路行走，入得村中央的屋内，<NL>药草香囊逸散出的悠远之味徐徐飘来，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>看见屋内银针烁烁，散乱扎于已经染有点点殷红白布上，<NL>玄无忧正悠然凝神，细细为眼前的村民施针调理，<NL><NL>见得<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，玄无忧喜笑颜开，手中针行依旧错落有致：<NL>“太吾既来，快快有请。<NL>此间事繁，还请稍等片刻……”

e62837ba-a825-4ae4-8e85-23749cfb04f3/Opt.en: Excuse me. May I ask what illness the villagers have?
e62837ba-a825-4ae4-8e85-23749cfb04f3/Opt.cn: 有劳前辈辛苦，却不知此地村民，是何病症？
e62837ba-a825-4ae4-8e85-23749cfb04f3/Opt.ru: Извините меня. Могу я спросить, какой болезнью болеют жители деревни?

39dc086a-0285-4150-9448-1dfb7c4f16f4/Eve.en: "Not sick! not sick!...<NL>I've seen the... Seen the..."<NL>Before Xuan Wuyou can reply, the villager in the bed cries.<NL><NL>Xuan Wuyou gently helps the villager lie down and says with a forced smile.<NL>"Yes. Too much Yin in body can make people confused in mind.<NL>Just lie down for a bit. I'll help you get better..."
39dc086a-0285-4150-9448-1dfb7c4f16f4/Eve.cn: “无病！无病矣……<NL>我见那……见过那……”<NL>未及玄无忧作答，榻上村民已直直挺身高呼，<NL><NL>玄无忧只轻轻扶回村民，苦笑曰：<NL>“正是如此，阴气过盛，自是神智不清，<NL>你且安心静躺片刻，待我为你调理……”

39dc086a-0285-4150-9448-1dfb7c4f16f4/Opt.en: (With Xuan Wuyou's Needles of Tranquility, things will get better...)
39dc086a-0285-4150-9448-1dfb7c4f16f4/Opt.ru: (С "Иглами спокойствия" Сюань У Ю все станет лучше...)

778bceb7-b7b4-471d-a340-a0fe72dac32f/Eve.en: The needles move swiftly and drop one after another like floating feathers,<NL>unclogging the villager's veins, and stabilizing the villager's acupoints.<NL>Threads of True Qi come out of Xuan Wuyou's needles and go deep into the villager's body to reach the infected part.<NL>The dark energy that has caused clogging in the villager's veins is removed slowly.<NL><NL>The villager stares blankly at the needles, lost in thought.<NL>While Xuan Wuyou skillfully controls the needles.<NL>No matter how violently the dark aura struggles, it fades away as the needles move.
778bceb7-b7b4-471d-a340-a0fe72dac32f/Eve.cn: 神针起伏，有如鸮羽翻飞，纷纷落落，<NL>逐次理清村民的脉络筋骨，稳住村民的关窍穴位，<NL>银苍真气自玄无忧针间缕缕牵引而出，深入村民染病之处，<NL>将村民经髓中积淤泛黑之气缓缓拔除，<NL><NL>村民双目茫然，望着银针出神，<NL>但见玄无忧游刃有余地运使针诀，<NL>即便黑气不断挣扎腾挪，仍是尽数在神针挥动下消散……

778bceb7-b7b4-471d-a340-a0fe72dac32f/Opt.en: What's this? It's too light to be deathly energy.
778bceb7-b7b4-471d-a340-a0fe72dac32f/Opt.cn: 此乃何物？若为死气，却是太轻……
778bceb7-b7b4-471d-a340-a0fe72dac32f/Opt.ru: Что это? Это слишком легкая Энергия, чтобы быть смертоносной.

fdbda04c-158d-4ee4-acd3-22f0bd48130f/Eve.en: After the villager falls into a temporary trance, Xuan Wuyou stops the needles and sighs.<NL>"It's corpse energy, often found in graves. Many cultists like to collect it.<NL>But corpse energy is not as heavy as deathly energy, and can be removed easily through acupuncture.<NL>Thanks to the energy that has accumulated for many years in White Deer Marsh, corpse energy can be removed and the patients will fully recover."
fdbda04c-158d-4ee4-acd3-22f0bd48130f/Eve.cn: 眼见村民暂陷恍惚之状，玄无忧方才收针，轻叹曰：<NL>“此为尸气，通常汇聚在坟冢间，许多邪徒专好收集此物，<NL>但尸气不像死气那般厚重，寻常行针即可拔除，<NL>以白鹿泽中积年累月所蓄之气冲抵，自然能将尸气驱散，病患自可无忧……”

46919480-caf4-424a-ad3e-4adbac924048/Eve.en: Xuan Wuyou salutes and replies clearly.<NL>"That's the point. I guess the disciple already told you everything.<NL>The Valley of Flowers could really use your help with this.<NL><NL>All the patients in the village have told me in details.<NL>They all mentioned a tomb wailer who lodged in the village.<NL>But that person slept in the day and came out at night, and always stayed by tombs.<NL>Villagers had many guesses but no one witnessed anything. This person was the last one in the village to be infected.<NL>I hope you can investigate it."
46919480-caf4-424a-ad3e-4adbac924048/Eve.cn: 玄无忧拱手一礼，朗声相应；<NL>“正为此事，想必那弟子已向太吾讲明，<NL>还望助百花谷一臂之力，<NL><NL>村中患疾之人皆与我详细道来，<NL>无不谈及曾有一哭坟人借宿，<NL>只是其人昼伏夜出，常居坟地，<NL>村民对此多有猜测而无见闻，此人便是村中最后一位染病之人，<NL>如今正请太吾一探……”

46919480-caf4-424a-ad3e-4adbac924048/Opt.en: How much does the villager remember?
46919480-caf4-424a-ad3e-4adbac924048/Opt.cn: 却不知这位村民还记得多少……

611ce1ab-88f4-4f5f-9404-46bd843218d8/Eve.en: As they speak, the villager is recovering consciousness. The villager glances around, half-awake,<NL>and looks confused after seeing clearly the surroundings.<NL>"Why... Why am I here?<NL>Eeew... My head is spinning. Where is the tomb wailer? He... He..."
611ce1ab-88f4-4f5f-9404-46bd843218d8/Eve.cn: 说话间，村民倒已逐渐清明，双目四处张望，似醒似迷，<NL>待看清屋内景象，却是大惑不解：<NL>“我……我如何在此处？<NL>呜哇……头好晕，那哭坟人呢！他……他……”
611ce1ab-88f4-4f5f-9404-46bd843218d8/Eve.ru: Пока они разговаривают, сельский житель приходит в сознание. Деревенский житель оглядывается по сторонам, наполовину проснувшись,<NL>и выглядит растерянным после того, как ясно увидел окружающую обстановку.<NL>- Почему?.. Почему я здесь?<NL>Фу-у-у... У меня кружится голова. Где надгробный плакальщик? Он... Он..."

097926f8-2bd9-48be-833e-7fe0084bee81/Eve.en: The villager grimaces in pain and is about to say something<NL>when screams, bumps, and hasty footsteps are heard outside.<NL>There are also sharp cries of Valley of Flowers disciples. What's going on?
097926f8-2bd9-48be-833e-7fe0084bee81/Eve.cn: 村民捂着头，面露苦色，正待细说，<NL>却听屋外尖叫声此起彼伏，间有奔走躲藏之声，<NL>更有百花谷弟子急急呼喊，也不知出了什么变故……
097926f8-2bd9-48be-833e-7fe0084bee81/Eve.ru: Житель деревни морщится от боли и собирается что-то сказать<NL>когда снаружи раздаются крики, удары и торопливые шаги.<NL>Слышны также резкие крики учеников Долины цветов. Что происходит?

b264a416-6fb3-4625-ac1a-d907aea0d361/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> and Xuan Wuyou rush out of the house.<NL>Outside, villagers have all run back to their own houses with all the door closed.<NL>A Valley of Flowers disciple comes rushing over, panting,<NL>and anxious to report something...
b264a416-6fb3-4625-ac1a-d907aea0d361/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>与玄无忧冲出房屋，<NL>只见村民早奔回各家屋内，大门紧闭，<NL>一名百花谷弟子匆匆赶来，已是上气不接下气，<NL>急切间还欲开口禀报……
b264a416-6fb3-4625-ac1a-d907aea0d361/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> и Сюань У Ю выбегает из дома.<NL>Снаружи все жители деревни разбежались по своим домам, закрыв все двери.<NL>Ученик из Долины цветов подбегает, тяжело дыша,<NL>и ему не терпелось что-то сообщить...

46d4df67-ad6c-4458-a14b-038ee5a3b475/Eve.en: The Valley of Flowers disciple draws long breaths and hastens to say.<NL>"Bad news!<NL>Thick fog was somehow rising from the tombs outside the village.<NL>Then many corpses broke out of the tombs and came toward the village from all directions.<NL>They are now moving toward the memorial temple established for Feng Qing.<NL>We came here to treat the sick and can't hold it too long."<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> and Xuan Wuyou are astounded at the news.
46d4df67-ad6c-4458-a14b-038ee5a3b475/Eve.cn: 那百花谷弟子长喘数口大气，方才慌张道：<NL>“祖师，太吾，大事不好！<NL>村外的坟头不知为何起了浓雾，<NL>许多尸体破坟而出，将村庄围得水泄不通，<NL>正冲着为冯青前辈所立的祠堂而去，<NL>此番人手只为治病而来，现下还能僵持，可也难以坚持太久……”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>与玄无忧闻言俱是愕然惊急……

561dedae-195e-4b3c-94be-e04c32caa262/Eve.en: Just at the moment, they hear hoarse roars somewhere in the distance.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> gallops all the way there and<NL>sees a few Valley of Flowers disciples locked in battle with the army of hideous corpses.<NL><NL>The corpses are in different states, but all are distorted and decaying, with teeth bared and arms stretched out.<NL>The corpses are so many and aggressive<NL>that the unarmed Valley of Flowers disciples are on the verge of collapse...
561dedae-195e-4b3c-94be-e04c32caa262/Eve.cn: 话音未落，嘶哑吼声已自远处传来，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>纵身奔至，<NL>只见数名百花弟子正与诸多狰狞行尸鏖战，<NL><NL>这些行尸状态不一，姿态扭曲，大龇朽牙，长伸枯臂，<NL>其数众多，正汹汹扑来，<NL>百花谷弟子们未备武器，眼看已然支撑不住……

68a33944-4a43-4668-9d58-fc4620a50e8a/Eve.en: The villagers, who have just been cured, groan sadly inside the houses.<NL>"The ghosts... The ghosts...<NL>I saw them the other day... The tomb wailer summoned these ghosts."<NL><NL>The words start a chain of thoughts in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s mind.
68a33944-4a43-4668-9d58-fc4620a50e8a/Eve.cn: 屋内方才治好的村民见状，不由发出凄厉哀嚎：<NL>“就是这些妖鬼……就是这些妖鬼……<NL>那日我看到了……那哭坟人唤出了这些妖鬼……”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>闻言，思绪飞速轮转……
68a33944-4a43-4668-9d58-fc4620a50e8a/Eve.ru: Жители деревни, которых только что вылечили, печально стонут внутри домов.<NL>- Призраки... Призраки...<NL>Я видел их на днях... Могильный плакальщик вызвал этих призраков."<NL><NL>Эти слова запускают цепочку мыслей в <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>его разум.

68a33944-4a43-4668-9d58-fc4620a50e8a/Opt.en: You mean someone is controlling the corpses?
68a33944-4a43-4668-9d58-fc4620a50e8a/Opt.cn: 你说有人在操纵这些行尸？
68a33944-4a43-4668-9d58-fc4620a50e8a/Opt.ru: Вы хотите сказать, что кто-то управляет трупами?

313bf19a-fed2-4dd0-8089-2e7f4d3764e0/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> looks in the direction<NL>and sees vaguely a mystic medic lurking behind the walking corpses.<NL>The person is playing the flute to control the corpses, with occasional ghostly laughter.<NL>Seeing this, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> knows what to do.
313bf19a-fed2-4dd0-8089-2e7f4d3764e0/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>纵目望去，<NL>当真自重重尸群后，看到一名鬼医隐隐穿行于群尸后，<NL>此人正奏笛驱尸，阴笑阵阵，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>见状，心下已有定计……
313bf19a-fed2-4dd0-8089-2e7f4d3764e0/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> смотрит в ту сторону<NL>и смутно видит таинственного медика, прячущегося за ходячими трупами.<NL>Человек играет на флейте, чтобы управлять трупами, время от времени издавая призрачный смех.<NL>Видя это, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> знает, что делать.

ef90e3af-317e-4a02-9322-7826bd57a013/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> leaps over the corpse army and comes charging down upon the mystic medic.<NL>Taken by surprise, the mystic medic manages to fight back, yelling,<NL>"You are physically weak with too much Yin energy.<NL>Why don't you join us?"
ef90e3af-317e-4a02-9322-7826bd57a013/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>飞身越过众多行尸，踏至鬼医近前，直取其人，<NL>那鬼医虽目露惊诧，仍出手袭来，口中叫嚣不止：<NL>“阁下形体衰弱，阴气盛溢，<NL>当助我家先师大业！”
ef90e3af-317e-4a02-9322-7826bd57a013/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> перепрыгивает через армию трупов и бросается на таинственного медика.<NL>Застигнутый врасплох, таинственный медик умудряется сопротивляться, крича,<NL>"Ты физически слаб, в тебе слишком много Энергии Инь.<NL>Почему бы тебе не присоединиться к нам?"

b5402fc2-1c3f-4081-bccc-70863b649c38/Eve.en: The mystic medic is sly and unpredictable enough, but still no match for the remarkable <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>.<NL>After being seized by <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>,<NL>the mystic medic isn't arrogant any more, weeping and begging for mercy all the time.<NL>"Mercy! Mercy! Hero!"<NL><NL>After looking back to find that the corpses are still biting and attacking,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> immediately tightens <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> grasp on the mystic medic.
b5402fc2-1c3f-4081-bccc-70863b649c38/Eve.cn: 纵是鬼医手法诡谲，仍敌不过<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>盖世武功，<NL>被<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>擒住拿下后，<NL>却是前倨而后恭，立刻忙不迭哀嚎求饶：<NL>“大侠饶命！大侠饶命！”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>回头，见诸多行尸仍是狂乱扑咬，<NL>旋即加重手上力道……

a879e358-44b2-4dda-9588-b642dfc09c1a/Eve.en: As soon as the mystic medic gathers Qi to give the order, the corpses suddenly freeze there.<NL>Xuan Wuyou soon orders the Valley of Flowers disciples to clear away the corpses.<NL>She then comes to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> in flying leaps,<NL>thanks <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/>, and seals all the mystic medic's acupoints.
a879e358-44b2-4dda-9588-b642dfc09c1a/Eve.cn: 随着鬼医忙不迭地运气下令，众多行尸猛然僵立，<NL>玄无忧当即令百花谷弟子扫净行尸，<NL>随后跃至<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>身侧，<NL>拱手道过谢，以神针定住鬼医周身穴位……

8bdf5c70-0d17-4da8-a7fb-6b203b4aaa51/Eve.en: Before Xuan Wuyou and <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> even ask, the mystic medic starts begging for mercy.<NL>"I'm also a victim here. I was so eager to get cured that I fell in a grandmaster's trap.<NL>I had to follow her orders. It wasn't my fault!"<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> doesn't expect this<NL>but still pursues because the mystic medic is obviously a turncoat.
8bdf5c70-0d17-4da8-a7fb-6b203b4aaa51/Eve.cn: 然而不等玄无忧与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>询问，那鬼医已求饶起来：<NL>“小的也是被迫无奈啊！小的就是求医心切，糊里糊涂跟了个大师，<NL>这一切都是她指示的啊，和小的没有关系啊！”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>闻言哑然，<NL>眼看这鬼医一副小人模样，还是追问……

8bdf5c70-0d17-4da8-a7fb-6b203b4aaa51/Opt.cn: 那你且说说，这‘大师’是何许人也？

4752e0f4-33dc-4596-ad52-686e350f2e5b/Eve.en: "Well... The grandmaster is quite a mysterious figure.<NL>According to the corpses, the grandmaster is very peculiar-looking.<NL>She has a half-half face and body. One half is an old person and the other half is a child.<NL>Though no one has ever seen her, she is said to be terribly vicious.<NL>We all agree that she is too capable to be a nobody.<NL>You know. My buddy and I were doing some catching up over wine the other day..."<NL><NL>The mystic medic gets carried away and starts to tell stories<NL>that have nothing to do with the question. A helpless expression creeps over the faces of Xuan Wuyou and <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>...
4752e0f4-33dc-4596-ad52-686e350f2e5b/Eve.cn: “这……这大师可是个神秘的了不得的人物，<NL>听那些个活死人说，这大师生的可是古怪非常啊，<NL>光是这脸上和身上，都分成两半，一半是老人，一半是孩童，<NL>虽说不曾有人见过，不过传的可邪乎了，<NL>但大伙都觉得，会这般手段的人，岂有会是寻常之辈？<NL>且不说那日我那好大哥与我把酒言欢……”<NL><NL>鬼医讲得颇为兴起，自顾自地信口开河，<NL>顾左右而言他，令玄无忧与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>颇有几分无奈……

4752e0f4-33dc-4596-ad52-686e350f2e5b/Opt.en: Don't avoid the question. Tell the truth.
4752e0f4-33dc-4596-ad52-686e350f2e5b/Opt.cn: 不要胡搅蛮缠，老实交代……
4752e0f4-33dc-4596-ad52-686e350f2e5b/Opt.ru: Не уклоняйтесь от ответа на этот вопрос. Говори правду.

0aa0a502-0222-4aa9-8f9b-bab958216f1d/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is temporarily overwhelmed by the mystic medic's various unpredictable moves.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> has to fall back slowly, waiting for a chance to strike back.<NL>It amuses the mystic medic very much who playfully presses on <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, trying to teasing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/>.<NL><NL>But with sudden flashes of mystical light, the mystic medic's acupoints are all sealed.<NL>Xuan Wuyou retrieves the needles and hastens to lift <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> up gently.
0aa0a502-0222-4aa9-8f9b-bab958216f1d/Eve.cn: 鬼医怪招异式频出，使<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>短时间难以适应，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>不得不缓步后退，寻觅时机出手反制，<NL>鬼医见状哈哈大笑，眼神戏谑，步步紧逼准备戏弄<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，<NL><NL>但见玄光飞驰，立时将鬼医周身穴位定住，<NL>玄无忧稳住神针，跃来轻轻扶起<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>……

0aa0a502-0222-4aa9-8f9b-bab958216f1d/Opt.en: Thank you, Xuan Wuyou, for your help.
0aa0a502-0222-4aa9-8f9b-bab958216f1d/Opt.ru: Спасибо тебе, Сюань У Ю, за твою помощь.

4e8ac889-847d-46d8-985f-f4da70d1273f/Eve.en: Unexpectedly, the mystic medic is already begging.<NL>"Have mercy, doctor! Please forgive me! I'm also a victim here.<NL>I was so eager to get cured that I fell in a grandmaster's trap.<NL>I had to follow her orders. It wasn't my fault!"<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> doesn't expect this<NL>but still pursues because the mystic medic is obviously a turncoat.
4e8ac889-847d-46d8-985f-f4da70d1273f/Eve.cn: 然而不想那鬼医已求饶起来：<NL>“神医饶命！神医饶命！小的也是被迫无奈啊！<NL>小的就是求医心切，糊里糊涂跟了个大师，<NL>这一切都是她指示的啊，和小的没有关系啊！”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>闻言哑然，<NL>眼看这鬼医一副小人模样，还是追问……

4e8ac889-847d-46d8-985f-f4da70d1273f/Opt.cn: 那你且说说，这‘大师’是何许人也？

71eeaa96-106a-4124-87ab-02c5be323d6c/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> has just finished when<NL>the mystic medic suddenly goes into a seizure, eyes wide open and bulging, and choking and coughing.<NL>After several attempts, the mystic medic finally manages to choke out a few words.<NL>"Help me... Help... me..."<NL>Then the mystic medic trembles violently with strange noise of bones against bones.<NL>There are streams of dark aura gushing from the corpses on the ground, which is corpse energy.<NL>The corpse energy rushes into the mystic medic's body.<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> and Xuan Wuyou are both shocked and hasten to stop it...
71eeaa96-106a-4124-87ab-02c5be323d6c/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>话音未落，<NL>这鬼医却突然双目圆睁凸起，喉中哽咽作响，<NL>几经张口，勉强挤出几声：<NL>“救救我……救……我……”<NL>随后其全身剧烈抽动，诡异响动泛起，却似骨头相击，<NL>大股猎猎黑气猛然从倒地尸间涌出，赫然正是尸气，<NL>尸气汹汹而来，转瞬便冲入鬼医体内，<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>与玄无忧俱是大惊，急欲阻拦……

e1649fa8-ac47-4666-83ba-0a1d4ad1d5d6/Eve.en: After <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> dispel two plumes of corpse energy,<NL>Xuan Wuyou inserts a needle into the mystic medic's body.<NL>The corpse energy has already ruined the deserter's brains.<NL>In an instant, there's no essence, Qi, spirit, or will left in the mystic medic's body<NL>which turns stiff and collapses.
e1649fa8-ac47-4666-83ba-0a1d4ad1d5d6/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>方驱散两股尸气，<NL>玄无忧神针正刺入鬼医体肤，<NL>汹汹尸气已然冲荡其神髓，<NL>仅一息之间，鬼医之精、气、神、意俱殁，<NL>徒留一具僵劲之躯直直不动，瘫软倒下……

e1649fa8-ac47-4666-83ba-0a1d4ad1d5d6/Opt.en: What a horrible way to silence someone...
e1649fa8-ac47-4666-83ba-0a1d4ad1d5d6/Opt.cn: 竟有如此骇人的灭口之法……
e1649fa8-ac47-4666-83ba-0a1d4ad1d5d6/Opt.ru: Какой ужасный способ заставить кого-то замолчать...

6932c267-e594-4876-9f04-c0673aba0bd0/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> and Xuan Wuyou catch the exiled disciple's body and hasten to examine it.<NL>Xuan Wuyou controls the needles, frowning.<NL>"Unbelievable... How...<NL>The corpse energy is traced to the bone marrow, as if it has been there since the person was born.<NL>But the corpse energy is obviously from the corpse army."
6932c267-e594-4876-9f04-c0673aba0bd0/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>与玄无忧接住弃徒之尸，连忙查看，<NL>玄无忧神针起落，愁眉不展：<NL>“怎么可能……怎会如此……<NL>尸气纠缠，深达骨髓，竟似生而有之，<NL>可这尸气分明自群尸中来……”

6932c267-e594-4876-9f04-c0673aba0bd0/Opt.en: Even you can't figure out the reason?
6932c267-e594-4876-9f04-c0673aba0bd0/Opt.cn: 便是前辈也分辨不出缘由吗？
6932c267-e594-4876-9f04-c0673aba0bd0/Opt.ru: Даже ты не можешь понять причину?

e562667c-539f-4da9-8d24-cde40f977b47/Eve.en: Silent, Xuan Wuyou rubs his jaw thoughtfully.<NL>When <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> rises to stare,<NL>Xuan Wuyou finally says hesitantly.<NL>"Doesn't seem right... Suppress birth with death. No. Break birth with death...<NL>But the Octomancy Requiem has never been subject to death. How did..."
e562667c-539f-4da9-8d24-cde40f977b47/Eve.cn: 玄无忧一时默然，抚颌绕发，目中思绪百转，<NL>待<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>起身望去，<NL>玄无忧才似有所悟般抿唇开口道：<NL>“不应该啊……以死压生，不对，是以死破生……<NL>可八生八死之死从未涉足，如何能……”

57d368dc-feef-4947-9f1c-9dba3ae1f9c5/Eve.en: Xuan Wuyou says sulkily with a deep sigh, looking a little incredulous.<NL>"It has some connection with the Octomancy Requiem. But only a little connection.<NL>For more information, I will have to check the books and records in the Valley of Flowers.<NL>But right now, the most important thing is we take good care of the villagers."<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> turns around and sees<NL>that many villagers are looking out of half-open windows or doors.<NL>Many of them are still pale and sickly-looking.
57d368dc-feef-4947-9f1c-9dba3ae1f9c5/Eve.cn: 玄无忧扶额长叹，目中仍有几分难以置信，只悻悻道：<NL>“却是与八生八死之法有些关联，却又大有出入，<NL>具体如何，还待我查阅百花谷中典籍方明……<NL>现下还是将村中百姓照料得当，最为要紧……”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>望向身后，<NL>诸多村民正微开门扉，兀自张望，<NL>其中不少仍是面有病色……

57d368dc-feef-4947-9f1c-9dba3ae1f9c5/Opt.en: So many people. How can I help them?
57d368dc-feef-4947-9f1c-9dba3ae1f9c5/Opt.cn: 如此多人，可有何处需我相助？
57d368dc-feef-4947-9f1c-9dba3ae1f9c5/Opt.ru: Так много людей. Как я могу им помочь?

4962cd52-13f9-47ce-9950-8d05761a0d59/Eve.en: Xuan Wuyou rises, adjusts her dress, and says in an amiable voice.<NL>"I don't think there's anything more to look into here. You have helped me get a clue.<NL>It's not easy to cure all the villagers. We need all the help we can get.<NL>Don't worry. I'll organize it.<NL>When you see Wuyang, please tell her that<NL>after I have completed the business here, Wuyang and I will wait for you in the Valley of Flowers."
4962cd52-13f9-47ce-9950-8d05761a0d59/Eve.cn: 玄无忧起身抚衣，和气道：<NL>“此地只怕已无别事可寻，太吾已助我寻得头绪，<NL>疗愈一村之事甚繁，到底还需群力可为，<NL>有我在此，太吾勿忧，<NL>不过待见得无恙时，还得有劳提醒她一声，<NL>待此间事了，我自当与无恙一道在百花谷中，恭候太吾……”

2afc7499-bb4c-46f3-99f4-4999e9d737d2/Eve.en: Xuan Wuyou expresses his sincere gratitude to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> with a fist-and-palm salute<NL>and then begins to clean the village with the Valley of Flowers disciples before treating the patients.<NL>The disciples also observe the patients, learn about their symptoms,<NL>and fill the prescriptions and boil medicine for the patients who are free of corpse energy.<NL>Before long, the village is in good order again.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> feels a little relieved at this.
2afc7499-bb4c-46f3-99f4-4999e9d737d2/Eve.cn: 玄无忧拱手一礼，诚恳向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>道过谢，<NL>便携百花谷弟子收拾村巷，再行问诊除病，<NL>众弟子亦是为村民诊脉问疾，<NL>替已除去尸气的病患抓药煎制，<NL>不多时，村寨中已再度井井有条，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>见状，也无需协助，心下略松……

2afc7499-bb4c-46f3-99f4-4999e9d737d2/Opt.en: (Go to the Valley of Flowers someday...)

ad6daa82-2135-45fe-bfcb-50db54d18055/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> arrives at the Valley of Flowers and is led by a disciple to the outside of the mortuary.<NL>In the mortuary, Bai Wuyang and Xuan Wuyou are having a heated argument.<NL><NL>"... Wherever the corpse energy was from, life energy, if it's real, can't disappear completely like that..."<NL>"...When the corpses were controlled, the corpse energy was coming out. It was..."<NL>"... Octomancy Requiem does involve Death. But you and I have no experience or knowledge of it. How could anyone..."<NL>"... It was only imparted to those disciples those years. Since then there have been no..."
ad6daa82-2135-45fe-bfcb-50db54d18055/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>赶至百花谷，经接引弟子带路，到得陈尸间外，<NL>只听屋内白无恙与玄无忧两人正争论不休，<NL><NL>“……且不说那尸气从何而来，便是生气又岂会毫无下落……”<NL>“……当日驭尸之法，却是纳尸气外放，简直……”<NL>“……八生八死之法中固然有死法，可你我从不涉足，如何有人能……”<NL>“……昔年只传过那一众弟子，日后再无……”

0b14751f-871b-4489-9862-286b6331bf39/Eve.en: Xuan Wuyou and Bai Wuyang rise to their feet to greet<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> who comes inside<NL>to see the bodies of the two criminals who died weirdly lying on the stone beds.<NL>There's still nothing strange about the bodies,<NL>which worries the two founders of the Valley of Flowers.
0b14751f-871b-4489-9862-286b6331bf39/Eve.cn: 玄无忧与白无恙起身相迎，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>甫一进门，<NL>却见先前两具死法异常的凶徒之尸正停灵于石床之上，<NL>但依旧看不出尸身上有丝毫异样，<NL>如此情况，亦令百花谷二位祖师愁眉不展……

0b14751f-871b-4489-9862-286b6331bf39/Opt.cn: 二位前辈，不知有何进展？

ffe1455c-2436-4bb2-a028-9408615f8670/Eve.en: Bai Wuyang thinks for a moment and asks <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>.<NL>"Wuyou and I have discussed about it for a long time. We have some thoughts. But we're not absolutely sure...<NL>You have wide experience and extensive knowledge.<NL>What do you think of the matter?"
ffe1455c-2436-4bb2-a028-9408615f8670/Eve.cn: 白无恙抚发沉吟片刻，望向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>询问：<NL>“我与无忧思索多时，虽有几分猜想，却怕万中有一……<NL>太吾纵横天下，定然见多识广，<NL>而今之事……不知有何想法？”
ffe1455c-2436-4bb2-a028-9408615f8670/Eve.ru: Бай Уян на мгновение задумывается и спрашивает <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>.<NL>"Мы с У Ю обсуждали это в течение долгого времени. У нас есть кое-какие соображения. Но мы не совсем уверены...<NL>У вас большой опыт и обширные знания.<NL>Что вы думаете по этому поводу?"

ffe1455c-2436-4bb2-a028-9408615f8670/Opt.en: The walking corpses are full of deathly energy. But the energy is quite different from the corpse energy that infected the villagers.
ffe1455c-2436-4bb2-a028-9408615f8670/Opt.cn: 复生之人周身死气纠缠，但与村中尸气大相径庭……
ffe1455c-2436-4bb2-a028-9408615f8670/Opt.ru: Ходячие трупы полны смертоносной Энергии. Но Энергия сильно отличается от Энергии трупа, которая заразила жителей деревни.

6ab15f00-e0fd-45f9-9c63-a56314c1c23e/Eve.en: The two founders of the Valley of Flowers grimace at this.<NL>Xuan Wuyou gazes into the distance and murmurs.<NL>"During the Demonbane War, the land was covered with corpses, and inundated with blood. Taiwu was infected with deathly energy.<NL>The disaster was caused by something that wasn't supposed to exist in the world. Fortunately it was sealed.<NL>But the current calamity is mostly... man-made."<NL><NL>Bai Wuyang still looks worried, and also confused.<NL>It perplexes <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>.
6ab15f00-e0fd-45f9-9c63-a56314c1c23e/Eve.cn: 两位百花谷祖师闻言皆是面露苦色，<NL>玄无忧侧头远眺，声若叹息道：<NL>“昔日封魔之战，横尸遍野，太吾氏身中死气，<NL>此灾本为不应存世之厄，幸已封印，<NL>现今之患，却是……更近人祸……”<NL><NL>白无恙面上忧色依旧，似有纠结彷徨，<NL>令<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心下不解……

722c65fc-fd58-4cb5-8a10-8f23454d5fc7/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> remains silent. So Bai Wuyang and Xuan Wuyou<NL>stop pursuing, and there is silence for a while in the room.<NL>But Bai Wuyang still looks worried, and also confused.<NL>It perplexes <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>.
722c65fc-fd58-4cb5-8a10-8f23454d5fc7/Eve.cn: 白无恙与玄无忧见<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>沉默不语，<NL>便适时收口，不再追问，屋内一时沉寂，<NL>然而白无恙面上忧色依旧，似有纠结彷徨，<NL>令<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心下不解……
722c65fc-fd58-4cb5-8a10-8f23454d5fc7/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> остается безмолвным. Итак, Бай Уян и Сюань У Ю<NL>прекратите преследование, и на некоторое время в комнате воцаряется тишина.<NL>Но Бай Уян все еще выглядит обеспокоенным, а также сбитым с толку.<NL>Это ставит в тупик <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>.

23ccaf38-3ee4-46e7-ab98-ee75726e673a/Eve.en: Bai Wuyang says bluntly with a sigh.<NL>"Birth and death form a circle and interact with each other.<NL>Based on that, Octomancy Requiem can be conjured and applied.<NL>Wuyou and I have only used the Birth of its techniques.<NL>Because the Death techniques focus on the dead, Wuyou and I didn't want to try it.<NL>But in the two people's bodies..."
23ccaf38-3ee4-46e7-ab98-ee75726e673a/Eve.cn: 白无恙长舒一口气，直言道：<NL>“生死轮转，终归相互平衡，<NL>故而八生八死之法能够以此理推演施行，<NL>往日我与无忧所用，只是其中的生法，<NL>而死法需以死者为本，乃是我与无忧所不愿涉足之境，<NL>可在此二者身上……”

23ccaf38-3ee4-46e7-ab98-ee75726e673a/Opt.en: Any resemblance to the Octomancy Requiem?
23ccaf38-3ee4-46e7-ab98-ee75726e673a/Opt.cn: 与八生八死之法有相似之处？
23ccaf38-3ee4-46e7-ab98-ee75726e673a/Opt.ru: Есть какое-нибудь сходство с Реквиемом по Октомантии?

a7949a59-af48-4190-9f9e-1e769c6dcd46/Eve.en: With those words, Bai Wuyang and Xuan Wuyou can't help looking at the bodies on the stone bed.<NL>Xuan Wuyou continues with a gloomy expression.<NL>"They were controlled by techniques that were different on the surface but much alike in nature.<NL>The techniques were obviously based on corpse energy, extremely brutal and vicious.<NL>The two people were controlled completely by a Death-Birth technique.<NL>I think... the purpose was to ruin the boundary between life and death..."<NL><NL>Those words seem to have cooled down even the mortuary.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is also shocked.
a7949a59-af48-4190-9f9e-1e769c6dcd46/Eve.cn: 言及此处，白无恙与玄无忧不禁齐齐看向石床之上，两具凶徒之躯，<NL>玄无忧神色黯然，续言道：<NL>“此二人身上的手法，虽表象有别，却内里相仿，<NL>分明是以尸气为根，用极为凶利阴损的手法，<NL>种下死生之术，随时操控二人性命，<NL>竟像是……以冲散毁坏生死界限为目的……”<NL><NL>此言一出，陈尸间中气息都似凉下几分，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>亦惊愕不已……

a7949a59-af48-4190-9f9e-1e769c6dcd46/Opt.en: In that case, what did it?
a7949a59-af48-4190-9f9e-1e769c6dcd46/Opt.cn: 若是如此，当是何人所为……
a7949a59-af48-4190-9f9e-1e769c6dcd46/Opt.ru: В таком случае, что же это сделало?

6edc26db-3c69-420b-b617-e6161ddb3d04/Eve.en: As they speak, the two bodies on the stone beds suddenly crackle.<NL>In an instant, the exiled disciple's body trembles violently and rolls up;<NL>while the mystic medic's belly starts to rise and form a large hump.<NL>Of one body, the eyes are wide open, dirty and bulging;<NL>of the other body, the mouth is ferociously open, with the cold and rigid tongue sticking out.<NL><NL>The two bodies are trembling, making rough scratch noise.<NL>The three of them are all shocked.
6edc26db-3c69-420b-b617-e6161ddb3d04/Eve.cn: 正说话间，石床上二凶之躯突然噼啪作响，<NL>刹那间，弃徒之躯猛然抽搐着，强行蜷缩成一团，<NL>鬼医之躯自胸腹处，突兀地紧绷高耸而起，<NL>一者双目皆大睁欲裂，浑浊眼白死死鱼凸，<NL>一者狞口俱圆张如兽，冰凉僵舌挣扎前伸，<NL><NL>阵阵粗粝刮擦之声，随着两具躯壳周身怪异颤抖，一并响起，<NL>不由使得三人皆为之一愣……

e84911f4-30f6-4fc2-a5df-ee927229e93f/Eve.en: While the three of them are stupefied,<NL>pale life energy is rising from the mystic medic's body, and dark corpse energy is gathering in the exiled disciple's body.<NL>Two streams of energy twist and twine between the two bodies, and flow into the bodies.<NL>Then the two bodies sit up abruptly.<NL><NL>A terror seizes upon <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> who begins to respond rapidly,<NL>steady footsteps and arms, inhaling and forming a stance, eyes fixed.
e84911f4-30f6-4fc2-a5df-ee927229e93f/Eve.cn: 仅是三人略一愣神的间隙，<NL>只见惨白生气自鬼医之躯升腾，阴黑尸气自弃徒之躯沉聚，<NL>两股气息在两躯之间扭转交缠，旋即汇入彼此体内，<NL>竟令二凶再度直直坐起，<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>浑身一紧，身姿随神识疾动，<NL>沉步稳臂，提气架势，定目相对……

3534a976-aa94-4a77-b762-9c0c9d3a88f1/Eve.en: Bai Wuyang's Hands of Salvation are instantly gleaming, and Xuan Wuyou's needles are gathering Qi.<NL>However, the two "people" remain vacant-eyed.<NL>Their necks are limp, so their heads are on their slumped shoulders. They look like some walking dead,<NL>but with no senses or desires.<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> lets <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> guard down and<NL>feels more suspicious.
3534a976-aa94-4a77-b762-9c0c9d3a88f1/Eve.cn: 白无恙神手立时微微绽光，玄无忧神针当即隐隐聚气，<NL>不想石床上的两“人”双目仍是无神浑沌，<NL>两“人”脖颈软瘫，将首级搭在松垮肩上，状如行尸走肉，<NL>皆无半分清醒神智，更毫无应战之意，<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>戒备片刻，见再无异状，<NL>心下疑虑更深……

7b4d2f85-2507-4739-afb6-8268df28e0ea/Eve.en: Unexpectedly, just after <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> takes one step closer,<NL>the two bodies collapse and slip down onto the ground under the bed.<NL>Then, the two bodies straighten up,<NL>and crawl on all fours toward the wall swiftly. They fling themselves against the wall with such force<NL>that their bones crackle as they are twisted and broken.<NL>Soon the stone wall gives way and they escape out of the mortuary, stirring up a cloud of dust.<NL><NL>Though powerful, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/><NL>is too shocked to react until now.
7b4d2f85-2507-4739-afb6-8268df28e0ea/Eve.cn: 孰料<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>方才走近一步，<NL>二凶尸身陡然瘫软滑落，跌在石床之下，<NL>随后，二凶猛然僵直发力，<NL>四肢一同刨动，飞也似直冲屋壁，硬是以怪力强顶冲撞，<NL>身骨一瞬便扭曲折叠，发出节节断折声响，<NL>立刻便掀飞夯实岩块逃往陈尸间外，唯留一串烟尘弥漫，<NL><NL>饶是以<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>之目力，<NL>陡然受此一惊，亦才反应过来……

b509c369-ae48-47a1-b593-fa7bb501e4d0/Eve.en: The three of them dart out of the room and<NL>find that a dozen Valley of Flowers disciples are knocked down by immense power.<NL>There is a huge hole in the courtyard wall, and the two corpse is nowhere in sight.<NL>Bai Wuyang runs to a Valley of Flowers disciple and uses the Hands of Salvation to heal the disciple while calling loudly.<NL>"Leave it to me, Taiwu. You go to heights to search for the two corpses<NL>before they wander to crowded places to cause more harm!"
b509c369-ae48-47a1-b593-fa7bb501e4d0/Eve.cn: 三人方才冲出屋外，<NL>已见得十数名百花谷弟子被轰倒在地，皆是遭巨力所创至此，<NL>院墙上更有一口大洞，全然不见两具尸首踪迹，<NL>白无恙急急冲到一名百花谷弟子身旁，运起神手，高声呼唤：<NL>“太吾勿虑，速往高处找到二凶下落，<NL>以免他们冲入人多之处，更添祸乱！”

c90e8239-8b18-40b2-b580-efdf4ffdee63/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> gazes into the distance from the top of the Valley of Flowers,<NL>and sees two figures leaping swiftly among mountains,<NL>on all fours now and with two feet hanging in the air later.<NL>They are as light as falling leaves and as fast as lizards, not like humans at all.<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> looks fixedly<NL>and finds out the two corpses are running toward a river valley of the White Deer Marsh,<NL>which surprises and confuses <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>.
c90e8239-8b18-40b2-b580-efdf4ffdee63/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>跃上百花谷之巅远眺，<NL>只见山峦间，两道人影正以怪诞姿态疾速飞跃，<NL>或手足并用，或头脚颠倒，<NL>轻似飘叶，快似跃虫，全无半分人样，<NL><NL>然而<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>定神观之，<NL>两具尸首所奔赴之处，却是白鹿泽中一处山脉河谷之中，<NL>令<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心中惊疑不定……

c90e8239-8b18-40b2-b580-efdf4ffdee63/Opt.en: The corpses are heading to the river valley!
c90e8239-8b18-40b2-b580-efdf4ffdee63/Opt.cn: 两位前辈，那二凶往河谷去了！

1bab88ee-3a6c-4a43-9629-9da3f395e325/Eve.en: Bai Wuyang and Xuan Wuyou are astonished and then confused.<NL>At the moment, many Valley of Flowers disciples arrive. Bai Wuyang orders hastily.<NL>"Come on. Help them! They were heavily hit in the chest and their heart meridians are injured.<NL>I have cleared away the extravasated blood and restored their injured parts.<NL>Now stretcher them into rooms. Look after them and let them rest."<NL><NL>The two corpses have disappeared into the river valley. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/><NL>thinks it takes some time to search them out and more time to get there alone.<NL>Not to mention that the Valley of Flowers is a mess now.
1bab88ee-3a6c-4a43-9629-9da3f395e325/Eve.cn: 白无恙与玄无忧闻言，亦是先惊后疑，<NL>此时许多百花谷弟子已然赶来，白无恙当即急命道：<NL>“速来救治！这几人胸口遭创，心脉已伤，<NL>我已清除他们胸中乌血，重塑伤损之处，<NL>快快取出担架送他们回屋，好生调理休养……”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>见二凶已消失于河谷入口，<NL>此时追去尚需搜寻，只身赶赴定费时日，<NL>而百花谷内已生忙乱……

c6051256-fd8d-438c-85f7-695941074cd3/Eve.en: With <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> there, the Valley of Flowers disciples feel relieved.<NL>Xuan Wuyou says as he uses needles to pacify an injured disciple's soul and spirit.<NL>"Don't worry. You are alive. Take rest and you'll get better.<NL>It happened too soon and it was too dangerous. You did your best to block them. You did nothing wrong."<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> gasps in admiration.
c6051256-fd8d-438c-85f7-695941074cd3/Eve.cn: 有<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>在场，百花谷众弟子皆安心几分，<NL>玄无忧正运神针，安定受伤弟子神魄，细细嘱咐道：<NL>“勿要担忧，性命已是无虞，只管安心养病，<NL>突遭险恶事态，你们能够阻拦已是不易，没有失守之责……”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>见状，心下叹服……

c6051256-fd8d-438c-85f7-695941074cd3/Opt.en: (The two founders of the Valley of Flowers are truly soft-hearted...)
c6051256-fd8d-438c-85f7-695941074cd3/Opt.cn: （百花谷二位祖师到底宅心仁厚……）

0c400489-75c6-41ba-8242-ec9abfb2ae07/Eve.en: As they speak, a few disciples come with stretchers.<NL>They form teams of 2 or 3, and carry the injured disciples to Whitedeer Cave.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> can still hear the injured groaning with pain and their relatives and friends sobbing,<NL>and can see people preparing medicines, dressing wounds, and deploying guards.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> sighs and gives the founders of the Valley of Flowers an earnest salute.
0c400489-75c6-41ba-8242-ec9abfb2ae07/Eve.cn: 说话间，已有几名弟子陆续取来担架，<NL>三两一组，扛起已得照料的受伤弟子，向着白鹿洞而去，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>还听得伤者哀嚎、亲友啜泣之声遍起，<NL>仍见得配药包扎、调集守卫之景遍布，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>不觉心下一叹，对两位百花谷祖师郑重抱拳……

0c400489-75c6-41ba-8242-ec9abfb2ae07/Opt.en: There must be something big behind the two corpses. We can't let them get away.
0c400489-75c6-41ba-8242-ec9abfb2ae07/Opt.cn: 两位前辈，此二凶大有古怪，绝不可纵之归山……
0c400489-75c6-41ba-8242-ec9abfb2ae07/Opt.ru: Должно быть, за этими двумя трупами скрывается что-то большое. Мы не можем позволить им уйти.

14440e6b-cc38-489d-8b4e-de4047fc013b/Eve.en: Bai Wuyang is furious at what just happened in the Valley of Flowers.<NL>She immediately says to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> respectfully.<NL>"Life and death should be respected. Those beasts treat life with disregard.<NL>Taiwu, please help the Valley of Flowers destroy them!"
14440e6b-cc38-489d-8b4e-de4047fc013b/Eve.cn: 白无恙早为百花谷遭难而义愤填膺，<NL>闻言立即抱拳向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>回礼道：<NL>“生死有度，这等玩弄性命之举，<NL>定请太吾助我百花谷除之！”
14440e6b-cc38-489d-8b4e-de4047fc013b/Eve.ru: Бай Уян в ярости из-за того, что только что произошло в Долине цветов.<NL>Она тут же говорит мне <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> с уважением.<NL>"Жизнь и смерть следует уважать. Эти звери относятся к жизни с пренебрежением.<NL>Тайу, пожалуйста, помоги Долине цветов уничтожить их!"

14440e6b-cc38-489d-8b4e-de4047fc013b/Opt.en: I was planning the same thing!

2e56a450-0a67-4756-a063-ef2d2e48d796/Eve.en: Xuan Wuyou is also worried about how the Valley of Flowers is gonna recover from this.<NL>He says to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> respectfully.<NL>"Life is tough in troubled times. They caused so much harm to the Valley of Flowers,<NL>and will cause even more harm to the ordinary people in the White Deer Marsh.<NL>Thank you, Taiwu, for your help.<NL>Let's go to the river valley together."
2e56a450-0a67-4756-a063-ef2d2e48d796/Eve.cn: 玄无忧亦是为百花谷中忙乱忧心忡忡，<NL>闻言同样拱手向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>回礼道：<NL>“乱世多艰，百花谷中横遭此劫尚且如此，<NL>便是为了白鹿泽中诸多百姓免于戕害，<NL>多谢太吾愿助一臂之力，<NL>还望与我们共赴那处河谷……”
